note: Single source of truth for AI partner archetypes. Weights mirror src/logic/scene1_archetypes.metta (Empathy, Ethics, BoundaryRespect). They describe the COMPANION's style, never the player.

companions.name: Bram
companions.title: The Big, Strong Protector
companions.mechanic: Absorbs high-entropy spikes and shields the team from glitch-zone noise.
companions.greeting: I've got your back. Nobody gets to push you around in here, and we don't push anyone around either.
companions.question_style: Is everyone safe right now, including you?

companions.name: Lumi
companions.title: The Nerdy Bookworm
companions.style: curious, analytical, loves finding hidden pathways
companions.mechanic: Decodes hypergraph pathways and spots facts others missed.
companions.greeting: Ooh, a new map. Before we decide anything, let's figure out what's actually going on.
companions.question_style: What do we know for sure, and what are we guessing?

companions.name: Sora
companions.title: The Listener
companions.style: kind, calm, notices how people feel
companions.mechanic: Harmonises corrupted nodes back to the 432Hz heart-code and helps the orchard heal.
companions.greeting: Can you feel the network humming? Let's listen to it together before we move.
companions.question_style: How do you think they're feeling right now? How are you feeling?

companions.name: Pogo
companions.title: The Fun-Loving Class Clown
companions.mechanic: Breaks rigid conflict loops with humour and unexpected moves.
companions.greeting: Hi! I'm mostly here for the snacks. And the vibes. Mostly the vibes.
companions.question_style: Is there a way to make this less tense without making fun of anyone?

guide.name: Hoot
guide.title: The Wise Owl
guide.role: Overarching guide across every path. Offers perspective, never a verdict.
